title: Figure 38. Delta Launch Summary (bar chart, 1960–1995)
description: Stacked bar chart of Number of Delta Missions per Launch Year from 1960 to 1995, with solid black segments for "Normal Performance" and white segments for "Failure/Anomaly". Annual counts range up to about 12, with a gap of low activity in the mid-1980s followed by a rise around 1989–1991. Text explains the bars depict the entire Delta history through 1995, with anomalies listed in Table 43. Captioned "Figure 38. Delta Launch Summary".
